blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) warned on Thursday that the Israeli government’s settlement plan and its continued violence against settlers in the West Bank violate international law. This follows Israel’s approval of a major settlement project in the West Bank, where it plans to build around 1,200 homes on land it calls E1, or East 1, to expand its Ma’ale Adumim settlement and connect it to Jerusalem. “We express our deep concern over recent developments in the West Bank.
